name: Exp_AdaptiveRenko
summary: This EA trades based on the AdaptiveRenko custom indicator, which uses ATR or StDev to dynamically size Renko bricks. It opens buy/sell positions when new Renko bricks signal a direction change, with configurable stop loss and take profit levels.
summary_zh: 该EA基于AdaptiveRenko自定义指标进行交易，该指标使用ATR或标准差动态调整Renko砖块大小。当新Renko砖块发出方向变化信号时开仓，配有可配置的止损和止盈水平。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于自适应Renko图表，通过ATR或标准差指标动态计算砖块厚度，实现根据市场波动率自动调整的突破交易。入场条件为：当指标第2缓冲区（UpVal）在信号K线有值且前一根无值时触发买入信号，当第3缓冲区（DnVal）在信号K线有值且前一根无值时触发卖出信号，这本质上捕捉的是Renko砖块方向反转的时刻。出场条件包括固定点数的止损（默认1000点）和止盈（默认2000点），以及反向信号平仓（如买入信号触发时平空头）。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，负值代表固定手数，正值代表按存款比例计算手数。资金管理依赖外部TradeAlgorithms.mqh库函数实现，策略本身没有追加仓位或加码逻辑。该策略的优势在于Renko过滤了市场噪音，自适应砖块大小能适应不同波动环境，但缺乏对滑点和点差的过滤。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on adaptive Renko charts, where brick size is dynamically calculated using either the ATR or Standard Deviation indicator, enabling breakout trading that auto-adjusts to market volatility. Entry conditions: a buy signal triggers when the indicator's buffer 2 (UpVal) has a value on the signal bar but not on the previous bar, and a sell signal triggers when buffer 3 (DnVal) has a value on the signal bar but not on the previous bar—this essentially captures Renko brick direction reversals. Exit conditions include a fixed stop loss (default 1000 points) and take profit (default 2000 points), plus reverse-signal closes (e.g., closing shorts when a buy signal fires). Position sizing is controlled via the MM parameter: negative values represent a fixed lot size, while positive values represent a percentage of the deposit. Money management relies on external TradeAlgorithms.mqh library functions, with no pyramiding or position-addition logic in the strategy itself. The strategy benefits from Renko's noise-filtering property and adaptive brick sizing for varying volatility regimes, but lacks spread and slippage filters.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 资金管理参数，负值为固定手数，正值为存款比例
parameters.description_en: Trade fraction or fixed lot; negative=lot size, positive=deposit percentage

parameters.name: Deviation_
parameters.description: 最大价格偏差点数（滑点容忍度）

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 获取入场信号的K线索引

parameters.name: Price
parameters.description_en: Price calculation method: High/Low or Close

pros: 自适应Renko砖块大小能根据市场波动率自动调整，适应不同行情环境
Renko图表天然过滤市场噪音，减少假信号干扰
参数设计灵活，可控制买卖开平仓权限、资金管理方式和波动率指标选择
pros_en: Adaptive Renko brick sizing auto-adjusts to market volatility, adapting to different market conditions
Renko charts naturally filter market noise, reducing false signal interference
Flexible parameter design allows control over buy/sell permissions, money management, and volatility indicator selection
cons: 缺乏点差过滤，在高点差环境下可能产生不利入场
依赖外部TradeAlgorithms.mqh库，核心交易逻辑不透明，难以审计风险
止损止盈使用固定点数而非ATR动态计算，在不同波动率环境下可能不合适
没有持仓检查逻辑，可能在已有同方向仓位时重复开仓
cons_en: No spread filter, which may result in unfavorable entries during high-spread conditions
Relies on external TradeAlgorithms.mqh library with opaque trading logic, making risk auditing difficult
Stop loss and take profit use fixed point values rather than ATR-based dynamic calculation, which may be inappropriate across varying volatility regimes
No position check logic, potentially opening duplicate positions in the same direction
improvements: 增加点差过滤和交易时间过滤，避免不利交易环境
使用ATR动态计算止损止盈距离，替代固定点数
增加持仓方向检查，避免同方向重复开仓
improvements_en: Add spread filter and trading session filter to avoid unfavorable trading conditions
Use ATR-based dynamic stop loss and take profit distances instead of fixed point values
Add position direction check to prevent duplicate entries in the same direction

risk_points: 核心交易算法封装在外部库中，内部逻辑不可审计
缺乏点差和滑点过滤，实盘可能产生额外亏损
固定止损止盈未考虑市场波动率变化
risk_points_en: Core trading algorithms are encapsulated in an external library with unauditable internal logic
Lack of spread and slippage filters may cause additional losses in live trading
Fixed stop loss/take profit does not account for changing market volatility
